desc: The Real Avid Ratchet Rest is a heavy-duty, front shooting bag designed to provide rock-solid support and customizable elevation for precision shooting. Its adjustable ratchet-style height system lets you fine-tune your rifle's position for consistent, repeatable shots, while the large size offers enhanced stability for bigger firearms. Built with rugged, weather-resistant materials and a comfortable grip base, this front shooting bag is perfect for benchrest practice, competition, or range work where accuracy matters.
